S Continental
is an album by
Ray Conniff
and His Orchestra & Chorus. It was released in 1962 on the
Columbia
label (catalog nos. CS 8576 stereo and CL 1776 monaural).
[
1
]
[
2
]
Overview
The album debuted on
Billboard
magazine's "
Top LPs
" chart on May 12, 1962, peaked at No. 6, and remained on that chart for 18 weeks.
[
3
]
It was his fourth album with 'S in its title, and his most successful one with 'S in its title.
AllMusic later gave the album a rating of three stars. Reviewer William Ruhlmann wrote that the album marked Conniff's return to "a familiar approach" with the vocals "back to 'da'das' and 'doot-doots.'"
